name: perceptual
_purpose: Fine-tune the base checkpoint with a perceptual (LPIPS) term added to the Charbonnier loss. Charbonnier alone optimises pixel error, whose cheapest minimiser is to smooth away low-contrast texture -- which is why the base model leads on PSNR/SSIM but trails on LPIPS. Launch with --init_from weights/base_best.pt.
_ship_rule: KLA combines PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS with undisclosed weights, so a large LPIPS gain is worth a small PSNR give-back, but not a large one. Ship only if LPIPS improves clearly AND PSNR drops by less than ~0.15 dB.
_batch_note: batch 8, down from 12: the frozen AlexNet used for LPIPS also needs VRAM on a 4 GB card.
